description: One-launch short-sequence GDN-2 recurrent forward with in-kernel q/k L2 normalization and FP32 state.

initial_state.note: K-major, read-only and never aliased with final_state.

o.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

final_state.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

domain.layout: Token-major BTHD inputs/output; K-major BHKV state; all tensors contiguous.
domain.gate_domain: Finite g<=0, 0<=erase_gate<=2 and 0<=w<=1. The public Python API calls this tensor b; g/b/w are activated by the layer.
domain.normalization: q and k are normalized in FP32 with eps=1e-6; q is then scaled by 128^-0.5.
domain.ownership: Each vector participant owns complete heads for all T; no head/state row crosses cores and no cross-core synchronization is used.
domain.aliasing: Inputs are read-only; o and final_state are fresh complete-overwrite outputs with disjoint storage.

default.reason: All arithmetic/state are FP32, but CCE register reductions may differ from the CPU reduction tree; bitwise equality is not required.

measured.static: ascriptor check 0 errors / 0 warnings, 258 ops. Fully vectorized (no per-key loop).
measured.board_cce: All 5 contract cases pass through the aclnn launcher on real 910B silicon at block_dim=8 (16 heads on 16 vector participants).
measured.performance: In-process runtime bridge (zero-copy), real_decode B1/T1/H16 bd8: 266.9 us/call vs torch_npu recurrence 4265.4 us/call = 16.0x. Correctness o relative-L2 3.2e-6.
measured.note: a5 measurements not inherited (AGENTS.md 6). Newton-refined rsqrt keeps relative-L2 within 1e-4.

provenance.disposition: Formula and public tensor semantics were independently reimplemented; no Triton source was copied.
Reused the already measured one-head-per-vector-core ownership and two-pass resident-state pattern, with distinct GDN-2 channel-wise erase/write math and in-kernel q/k normalization.
Mechanical a2 port: facade a5->a2 and device guard only; kernel algorithm unchanged. Vector-only kernel; does not exercise the split-K fp32 cube path (M10-081/M10-083).

release_scope.note: Repository-owned a2 port of the a5 gdn2_fused_recurrent unit; not part of Ascriptor 0.1.0. A2/A3 are deferred upstream (D-250).
